{"type":"text","timestamp":1794621760298,"sessionID":"ses_e28379ba0ffe5Xi1dHDd43R56b","part":{"id":"prt_1d7cae324001zLudWcowiWLg1O","messageID":"msg_1d7cabdac0017E8pIuqfeUsUh1","sessionID":"ses_e28379ba0ffe5Xi1dHDd43R56b","type":"text","text":"This mission failed and scores 0. The rover sampled five targets but ran out of battery at tick 47 of 50. A rover with a dead battery scores nothing, no matter what it collected.\n\n**What went right:**\n- I sampled t2, t4, t5 and t1 before their deadlines, plus the discovered target d1 (value 3, deadline 33).\n- The compass had a hidden error that turned every drive about 6° clockwise. I worked it out from the position readings and corrected for it. Because of it, my first tries at t3 and t5 missed. I went back and got t5; t3 was never sampled.\n- The rover reached base at tick 27 holding 6 of the 9 available points (about 0.67), with 20.8 battery left.\n\n**What went wrong:** I planned the route by time and distance and never added up the battery cost.\n- Each tick drains 0.5 whether the rover moves or not, plus 1 per metre driven and 3 per sample. That totals far more than I allowed for.\n- At tick 25, before seeing any telemetry from base, I queued the trip to d1 to save a tick. The rover only reached base at tick 27.\n- Sent commands can't be cancelled; only hitting a hazard or the map edge clears the queue, and neither was on the route. When I noticed the shortfall at tick 27, the d1 trip was locked in.\n- Getting d1 left 7.73 battery at tick 31. Just sitting still for the remaining 19 ticks costs 9.5, so death was certain.\n\nThe right move was to stay at base after tick 27. That would have ended with about 9.3 battery and a score of about 0.67. Even ending away from base after taking d1 would only have scored 0.5, and only if the battery had lasted.\n\n**For future runs:** check the battery budget (remaining ticks × 0.5 + every queued drive and sample) before sending each batch of commands. Don't queue an optional detour until there's enough battery margin to finish it and still survive to the end.","time":{"start":1794621760292,"end":1794621760297}}}
